# SignMessageLib

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/32c74b4101392888212aa04d9da684c28a4aa416/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/SignMessageLib.sol)

**Inherits:** [SafeStorage](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/contract.SafeStorage)

**Title:** SignMessageLib - Allows to sign messages on-chain by writing the signed message hashes on-chain.

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

## Constants

### SAFE_MSG_TYPEHASH

```solidity
bytes32 private constant SAFE_MSG_TYPEHASH = 0x60b3cbf8b4a223d68d641b3b6ddf9a298e7f33710cf3d3a9d1146b5a6150fbca;
```

## Functions

<a id="signmessage-bytes"></a>

### signMessage

Marks a message (`_data`) as signed.

<i>

Can be verified using EIP-1271 validation method by passing the pre-image of the message hash and empty bytes as the signature.

</i>

```solidity
function signMessage(bytes calldata _data) external;
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _data | `bytes` | Arbitrary length data that should be marked as signed on the behalf of address(this). |

<a id="getmessagehash-bytes"></a>

### getMessageHash

<i>

Returns hash of a message that can be signed by owners.

</i>

```solidity
function getMessageHash(bytes memory message) public view returns (bytes32);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| message | `bytes` | Message that should be hashed. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bytes32` | Message hash. |

## Events

### SignMsg

```solidity
event SignMsg(bytes32 indexed msgHash);
```
